title: Cosmic Plasma Orb
description: A transparent spherical orb floats in deep space, its interior filled with glowing blue electrical arcs and pink energy nodes. Surrounding the orb are multiple swirling rings of luminous purple, magenta and pink light trails with small floating particles against a starry black background.
prompt: A transparent glowing spherical orb floating in deep space, filled with bright blue branching electrical plasma arcs connecting to pink glowing nodes at its core. Multiple large swirling energy rings in vibrant purple, magenta and pink orbit around the sphere creating dynamic light trails and particle effects, dark starry space background, luminous and ethereal digital art
